title: John Lennon and Yoko Ono give multiple interviews | 1973
content:
John Lennon and Yoko Ono gave a number of interviews on 11 January 1973.

This was the week that Ono’s third solo album Approximately Infinite Universe was released. It was co-produced by her and Lennon.

The interviews took place at the couple’s apartment at 105 Bank Street in Greenwich Village, Manhattan. The publications included the East West Journal and The Village Voice.
